title: A pending changeset (`.changeset/7344-handler-string-any-mirrors.md`) and its pin test still say "nothing reads `AppComponentSchema.actions[]`" — measured false, and the sentence ships as CHANGELOG copy at the next release
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (session `session_01BAZFhALsQsGqxui8sNqM8s`) from the #6854 dev's out-of-scope findings (report on #6854, PR #7720). ⛔ Unassigned; grading and `domain:*` are triage's. Dedup: a natural-language search returned three related-but-different cards (#4202, #5610, #4282), so the instrument was live and none is this.

## The defect

- `.changeset/7344-handler-string-any-mirrors.md:32` (a **pending** changeset, i.e. future published CHANGELOG copy for `@object-ui/types`) carries the parenthetical "`AppAction.onClick` (nothing reads `AppComponentSchema.actions[]`)".
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/handler-keys-string-any-mirrors-7344.test.ts:58–60` records a reader census that omits `@object-ui/runner` — literally true as scoped, and the origin of the false sentence.

**Measured false** (the #6854 Zone-2 census, comment 5551453088 on #7469; re-read by this seat on `origin/main` `f96a781`): `packages/runner/src/LayoutRenderer.tsx` renders `AppComponentSchema.actions[]` — the `'button'` arm as toolbar buttons and the `'user'` arm as an avatar dropdown. What is true is narrower: no reader touches `onClick` on the action or on `items[]` (after PR #7720 deletes the last cast).

PR #7720 corrected the same sentence in the two `packages/types` rationale comments on `onClick` but deliberately did not edit another card's pending changeset or that card's pin (the bounded in-place-fix test fails on the "mechanical and pinned" leg). This card is the remainder.

## Fix shape

One editorial change: reword the parenthetical to the measured claim ("no renderer reads `onClick`, on the action or on `items[]`") in the changeset, and extend the census comment in the #7344 pin to name `@object-ui/runner` as a reader of `actions[]` (not of `onClick`). ⛔ No shape moves; Clause-② no. It has to land **before** the changeset is consumed by a release, or the false sentence becomes permanent CHANGELOG copy.

## Related

#7344 (the changeset's card) · #6854 / PR #7720 · #7469 (`pm:retriage` hung by this seat on the same false premise).
